task_description: GitHub issue #29: visualize the monster's care needs. Add a hunger/fullness gauge to StatsPanel (hungryLevel 0..10, full->hungry), enhance sprite-adjacent state badges (hunger NEW, dirty 💢, sleeping 💤) with a caution color near threshold that is not color-only (icon + accessible label), refactor mood derivation into an HP-aware pure function in ui-helpers.ts with unit tests, source the hunger cap/threshold from shared, and provide JA/EN parity for all new strings. Frontend-only (plus exporting the existing MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL const from shared); no backend/infra. Branch feat/care-needs-indicators; commit locally only (orchestrator pushes/opens PR/redeploys).
